bathAction.title: Wash legs
bathAction.tooltip: Wash the legs down to the feet.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(wash)] down [npc.her] [npc.legs] to [npc.her] [npc.feet], between the toes and back up the calves. Dirt and dust come away in the water. [npc.She] [npc.verb(rinse)] until the skin looks like [npc.her] own again. [npc.speech(Down to the feet. The day walks itself into the skin.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(prop)] a [npc.leg] into the water and [npc.verb(wash)] it slowly, calf to ankle to the spaces between [npc.her] toes, sighing at the heat. [npc.speech(My legs were aching. This is the good part.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(scrub)] down [npc.her] [npc.legs] and over [npc.her] [npc.feet] without ceremony, then [npc.verb(rinse)] the dirt away. [npc.speech(Feet too. Then we are done with them.)]
